description: AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API shows the field-delta-error 'quantity would go below zero' (field--error class) next to the delta field when a delta of -10 on a seeded quantity of 7 is rejected, with adjust-current-qty still 7

AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API shows the field-quantity-error (field--error class) naming the corrected quantity field when a corrected value of -2 on a seeded quantity of 7 is rejected, with adjust-current-qty still 7
AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API renders adjust-success and adjust-current-qty 0 with one adjust-audit row when a delta of -7 on a seeded quantity of 7 is accepted
